market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility expected into September. Yen intervention and BOJ decision create FX turbulence. Trade war escalation (Canada 50% tariffs) pressures global equities. Commodity strength (copper, oil) supports inflation hedges but pressures equities. September seasonality suggests 3-5% drawdown risk. CPI data this week is critical for rate path.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally bullish but concentration risk demands diversification. Copper supply deficit supports industrial metals for 12+ months. Trade fragmentation reshapes supply chains, benefiting domestic producers. Japan's fiscal trajectory may force global safe-haven rotation. Defense spending is a multi-year tailwind. AI drug discovery and precision medicine create new growth vectors.
